name: Mistral Code
desc: Enterprise AI coding assistant for JetBrains and VS Code
desc_zh: 面向企业的 JetBrains 和 VS Code 编码助手
solves: Enterprise teams need coding AI with audit logs and access control; Mistral Code bundles them with self-hosting.
solves_zh: 企业团队需要带审计和权限管控的编码 AI，Mistral Code 还支持私有化部署。
best_for: A regulated bank wants an in-IDE assistant that can run inside its own network.
best_for_zh: 受监管的银行想要一个能在自家内网运行的 IDE 编码助手。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — official news index of the vendor (https://mistral.ai/news)）。 Outside the window. First availability was a private beta on 2025-06-04. SURPRISE: the product URL now redirects to https://mistral.ai/products/vibe/, titled 'Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat) - AI chat and coding agent', so Mistral Code appears to have been folded into Mistral Vibe; confirm before adding. Built on the open-source Continue project. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：入库核对：产品页 mistral.ai/products/mistral-code 现在跳转到 Mistral Vibe 的产品页（标题「Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat) - AI chat and coding agent」）。入库后本档将标为已并入 vibe。 首次公开日期来源：https://mistral.ai/news/mistral-code/ 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://mistral.ai/products/vibe/）。 2026-11-25：status active → merged; superseded_by null → vibe。Mistral Code 的产品页现在跳转到 Mistral Vibe 的产品页（标题「Mistral Vibe (formerly Le Chat) - AI chat and coding agent」）：编程助手并入了面向办公与编程的 Vibe
